title: New World niche links keep their niche, the listing composer is noindex, and an empty list publishes no ItemList

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail: Three small crawl findings. (1) The 7 niche buttons on /themes/new-world linked to /create-a-space?kit=new-world?niche=<id>, so the niche was swallowed into the kit value; the link now joins with & when the base already has a query. (2) /classifieds/new answered 200 and indexable to an anonymous crawler; it is now noindex, nofollow. (3) 451 pages published an ItemList with no items (a city with no Circles, a filter with no matches), which validators flag; the JsonLd component now drops an ItemList whose itemListElement is empty and renders nothing when no node is left.

verify.note: Fails on main on all three. Passes once the link is well formed, the composer is noindex and empty ItemLists are dropped.
